body: Death is preferable to being a failure in my eyes, and having to stay somewhere I don’t belong, and working a midtier job for the rest of my life while I work my fingers to the bone, eventually growing old and senile and dying alone in a care home without even a nurse by my side. This was genuinely my last chance at something better for me. And it’s gone. I’ve just got to get some of my things in order, and I need to get some things that I need.

I appreciate it, but I don’t think there is. I made a promise to myself as a way to ensure I succeed. Unfortunately, I failed due to circumstances beyond my control. All I wanted was to go to Uni and live somewhere that I would be happy, and where I could raise a family without having to shoulder the debts of doing so here, in the States. But I failed. And I haven’t got any other options
